reason: Schedule/feasibility lens: the idea cannot reach a SCORED probe by 29 Sep 10:00 UTC with P >= 0.7. Gated as proposed, P is about 0.05-0.10; as an ungated rider, about 0.35-0.45. Six blocking facts, all checked in the repo. (1) Two prerequisites exist nowhere. (a) The x138 lab cache is NOT started. PROMPT_FRIEND_A.md (top block, 25 Sep 08:30) makes it conditional on #34 = 0.953, which scores ~17-20 UTC today. Friend A has made no commits since 24 Sep 04:12 MSK. The sibling divins schedule verdict costs this cache at 13-16 GPU-h (x138 ~3.5-4.5 min/video on 199 videos), and it must be sharded to <= 5 h to avoid the 27,000 s REPAIR_DEADLINE guard. (b) No harness replays x138's tail. experiments/l2_daughternet/replay/replay.py has 0 occurrences of readmit/gapfill/flow/lowdet (it replays the exp29/exp39 tail). The protocol's 'replay readmit/gap filler with vs without the external pool' therefore needs new code: an x138 cell-5 rerun on CPU over train-run geffs + low-det npz, plus official scoring, ~6-10 h of agent work (the divins sibling estimates 8-10 h for the same harness). (2) The weights and their contract are unknown. public.czbiohub.org is blocked here, and ultrack_supplementary/configuration/sparse_zebrafish ships only 'torch.jit.load' (README), with segment.sh reading PRECOMPUTED detection/edge layers (threshold 0.4, min_area 300 in config.toml). No inference, normalisation or scale script exists. Every reverse-engineering iteration needs a human: the user on Colab, or Vitalii pushing an internet-on Kaggle kernel. Agents cannot push, and this container has no data or weights to test against. (3) The hook as described is wrong, but this is repairable. '_LOWDET' is a list inside the GPU-shard predict subprocesses. It is flushed to /kaggle/working/edge_cache/<video>.npz (keys low_coords = t,z,y,x FULL-RES int16, low_score), and cell 5's load_low_detections reads the pool from there (x138 nb cell 4 'lowdet write', cell 5 l.1180-1300). Running simview 'inside the predict patch' would load a third network into both shard processes. The clean route is a NEW cell between prediction and post-processing that appends simview centroids (score 0.97) to each npz. It is guarded, non-fatal, and an exact no-op when off (npz sha256 unchanged). build_probe_kernel --base x138 supports only divinsert|leafprune (tools/build_probe_kernel.py l.12-18), so this is a new patch plus tests: 3-4 h of agent work, testable here only against a dummy torchscript. (4) Runtime is the binding risk on the hidden run (GUESS). ~100-130 hidden videos x 100 frames (CONTEXT l.14) = 10-13k full-res frames at 0.2-1 s/frame on a T4 in fp16 is 0.6-3.6 GPU-h, or 0.3-1.8 h wall on 2 GPUs, on top of x138's ~7.5 h (latency 7-10 h). That pushes the tail past REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27,000 s, which silently disables relink, readmit, gaps, safe divisions and linefit on the last movies, the opposite of the idea. So --set REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=36000 is mandatory (it exists: runtime-guard-audit schedule verdict). The 12 h hard limit then has ~2-4 h of margin, and P(timeout or guard trip) is ~5-15%. (5) GPU and people conflicts. From 26 Sep 00:00 the vitalii quota (30 GPU-h/week) must cover the x138 lab cache (if friend A is absent), 199-video simview centroids (the idea says 3 h; realistically 1-4 GPU-h plus zarr I/O), dummy runs for every other probe (~0.7 h each), and the divins retune line, which wants the same cache first. The user's Colab time and 1 of ~20 remaining slots compete with ideas the value lens rates higher. (6) The probe has almost no decision value. The value sibling puts the central public gain at ~+0.0002 (range -0.002..+0.001). The idea itself says it is 'unresolvable on the LB (noise ~0.003)'. An ungated score therefore cannot justify putting it in a final. Numbers checked: 424 + 28 of 135,729 -> +0.0033 ceiling (fn_anatomy_exp39.md, on exp39, not x138). Readmit gates as in DIFF.md s2 (radius 4, min 0.965, ONE pass, uncapped; gapfill <= 3%). The idea's 'ungated +30-40% nodes' claim comes from r2_critic.notes.
fix_if_any: Do not run it as its own line. Keep only a zero-slot, zero-lab-harness variant that piggybacks on work already planned. (a) Only if the ultrack-convention or dense-dorado lines obtain unet-simview.pt and a verified normalisation anyway (weights as a private dataset + a 2-clip sanity image) should the agent write the 'simview' patch for build_probe_kernel --base x138. It is a separate post-prediction cell that appends centroids to edge_cache/<video>.npz with score 0.97. Use the value sibling's safety filters: exclude candidates within 4.0 um (not 2) of any node, 2-frame support, cap <= 0.5% nodes per movie, no readmit next to a start whose parent is within 10 um. Use (1,2,2) downsampling + fp16, try/except non-fatal, forced --set REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=36000, and a no-op test (npz and submission.csv sha256 equal to exp56 when off). (b) Validate it inside the planned x138 train-run lab cache (the divins-retune kernel), NOT a separate one: add the simview append as a second low-det npz key (low_coords_ext) in that same run, so the cell-5 rerun can score pool-on vs pool-off on 6bba SELECTION/CONFIRMATION at zero extra GPU run. Gate: >= +0.0015, CI90 > 0, node ratio <= +0.5%, judged on 6bba only. (c) Hard stops: weights and normalisation not verified by 26 Sep 18:00 UTC -> drop. x138 cache or cell-5 rerun not ready by 27 Sep 12:00 UTC -> drop. Dummy-run simview time > 1.0 h for 4 videos -> drop (the hidden run would not fit 12 h safely). (d) If the gate passes, ship it ONLY as a rider inside an already-planned x138-family probe that is going out anyway, never in a dedicated slot.
realistic_public_gain: ~0 (central +0.0002, range -0.002..+0.001 per the value sibling; below LB noise 0.003; a guard trip or timeout from the added pass would make it negative)
realistic_private_gain: ~0 (central +0.0001, range -0.002..+0.001; hidden embryos are 6bba-like and out of domain for simview; runtime-guard downside identical on private since both come from one hidden run)

Human-bound, P(verified by 26 Sep 18:00) ~0.5-0.6. In parallel, 25 Sep 12:00-26 Sep 04:00, agent (container, no GPU): x138 train-run lab kernel builder (sharded <= 5 h, REPAIR_DEADLINE raised, geff + npz dumps), x138 cell-5 CPU rerun + official scoring harness (6-10 h, shared with the divins retune line), and the 'simview' patch + no-op tests (3-4 h). 26 Sep 00:05-10:00: x138 lab cache on 199 train videos, 13-16 GPU-h, 4 shards on vitalii 2-concurrent (or 2 on sasyami if friend A confirms). 26 Sep 14:00-18:00: simview centroids on 199 train videos (1-4 GPU-h, sasyami or vitalii), after the weights are verified. 26 Sep 18:00 - 27 Sep 06:00: cell-5 reruns pool-off/pool-on on 6bba SELECTION, then CONFIRMATION (Kaggle CPU / laptop, ~3-6 h with 4 procs). The gate passes with P ~0.2-0.3. 27 Sep 08:00-10:00: build the probe, then a dummy run on 4 test videos (~0.7-1 GPU-h, measure simview time), user OK. 27 Sep ~12:00: submit, with a hidden run of ~8-9.5 h; scored ~27 Sep 21:00 - 28 Sep 00:00, ~34 h before the 29 Sep 10:00 cutoff. The calendar has ~1 day of slack, but the joint probability is 0.8 x 0.55 x 0.55 (cache + harness on time) x 0.25 (gate) x 0.85 (runtime, dummy, user OK) ~ 0.05. Ungated rider path: the weights, patch and dummy run are done 26 Sep, submitted 26 Sep ~20:00, scored 27 Sep ~06:00. P ~0.8 x 0.55 x 0.85 x 0.9 (dummy passes) x ~0.8 (slot/OK) ~ 0.3-0.45, and a score inside LB noise cannot inform the finals. Both paths are < 0.70.
